name: Multi-Space Neural Radiance Field (MS-NeRF)
definition: A method that represents a scene using a group of feature fields in parallel sub-spaces instead of a single radiance field in Euclidean space, to handle reflective and refractive objects where multi-view consistency is violated.
summary: Multi-Space Neural Radiance Field renders reflective and refractive objects by representing scenes as multiple parallel feature fields, ensuring multi-view consistency where standard NeRF fails.
